full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white engraving shows a large stag beneath a spreading old tree, with a smaller deer farther back at the lower right. The stag's head and shoulders dominate the left foreground; its muzzle points right and slightly upward, and its branching antlers reach into the pale middle of the frame. Fine short cuts follow the direction of its fur, making the neck look rough and thick while the eye remains sharply defined. The smaller animal lifts its head from behind the first, its face and antlers partly framed by a compact cluster of foliage. Across the top, the old tree's heavy twisting boughs sweep from right to left, their bark built of curved, parallel dark lines. Smaller branches divide the bright sky into irregular patches, and little leaf clusters gather around their ends. In the distance, closely packed vertical strokes suggest trunks or falling light through the woods. Rounded masses of foliage fill the lower corners without dissolving the animals' silhouettes. The viewpoint sits at animal height, giving the nearer stag a strong profile against the open center. Nearly every surface is made of incised marks: white lines cut into dark fur and bark, while black hatching collects on pale ground. Light seems to filter from the upper left background, brightening the open sky and catching the upper planes of the animals; deep shadows remain under the branches and along the lower edge. The image contains no color or readable text. The overall composition is intricate and balanced, with the dark arching tree framing two alert forms and a luminous clearing of engraved marks between them.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形黑白版画呈现一只大雄鹿站在舒展的老树下，右下方稍远处还有一只较小的鹿。雄鹿的头和肩占据左侧前景，口鼻指向右方并微微抬起，分枝鹿角伸入画面浅色中部。短而细的刻线顺着皮毛方向排布，使颈部显得粗厚蓬松，同时眼睛仍被清楚界定。较小动物从前一只鹿后方抬头，脸和鹿角局部被一簇紧密枝叶围住。画面顶部，老树粗大的扭曲枝干从右扫向左，树皮由弯曲平行的深线构成。较细的枝条把亮天空分成不规则块，枝梢聚着小片叶群。远处密排的竖线暗示林中树干或穿林而下的光。圆浑的树叶团填在下方角落，却没有吞没动物剪影。视点与动物齐高，使近处雄鹿在开放中央前呈现强劲侧面。几乎所有表面都由刻出的痕迹构成：白线切过深色毛皮与树皮，黑色排线则积在浅底上。光似乎从左上背景的林间透来，照亮开阔天空并触及动物上方表面；深影留在枝下和下边缘。画面没有颜色或可读文字。整体构图精细而平衡，深色弧形树冠围住两个警觉身形，以及它们之间由刻线组成的发亮林间空地。
style_prompt_en: The image has a monochrome wood-engraving finish built entirely from closely controlled positive and negative lines. Curving parallel cuts describe dense rounded texture, while short directional hatches model softer surfaces and longer straight strokes create distance. Deep black regions are opened by fine white grooves; lighter areas receive dark crosshatching and stipple rather than smooth gray fill. Edges remain sharply cut near the focal area and break into thinner, busier marks farther back. Strong light is implied by reserved pale paper in the upper field, with heavy shade gathering below broad overhangs and at the base. Large dark branching masses frame a bright central opening, producing depth through mark density rather than color. The overall effect is tactile, meticulous, and dramatic, with every contour contributing to an interlocking rhythm of light and shadow.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有单色木刻版画质感，完全由受控的正负线条构成。弯曲平行的刻线描绘密实圆润的肌理，短而定向的排线塑造较柔软表面，较长直线则制造距离。深黑区域被细白沟槽打开，浅色区域以黑色交叉排线和点纹着调，而非平滑灰色填充。焦点附近的边缘切刻锐利，远处则散成更细、更繁忙的痕迹。上方保留的浅色纸面暗示强光，厚重阴影聚在宽阔遮蔽下方及基部。大型深色分枝形框住亮中央开口，以笔迹密度而非颜色构建纵深。整体效果可触、细密且戏剧化，每条轮廓都参与互锁的光影节奏。
theme_en: A stag and smaller deer beneath an old tree in a densely hatched woodland engraving
theme_zh: 密集排线林地版画中，老树下的雄鹿与较小的鹿
name: Wood engraving
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
